ns2:section.sectionText: Accountancy course prerequisites are strictly enforced. The Accounting Department will not allow students to advance in the accounting curriculum if they have not met the required prerequisite for previous accountancy courses taken.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Curric Unassigned or Technical Systems Management or Crop Sciences or Accountancy or Finance or Business Administration or Agr & Consumer Economics or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Information Systems or Operations Management major(s).
